1624493107784912896.a: I used FreeBSD almost exclusively for Internet facing servers until Debian was really solid mid 2000s. Linux was used for back office stuff that could be rebooted with minimal expense. ie. Shutting down the insurance claims system to unwind a kernel bug for example was expensive.

1624493110909599749.a: Some of the FreeBSD servers had uptimes of 1000 days with no security vulnerabilities exposed. FreeBSD was terrible at maintaining TCP sessions though. Linux ran IRC servers so much more reliably than FreeBSD; the FreeBSD IRC networks were split brain in different ways every day.
